goal: Prove that the compiler of ADR-0002, run on the S2 models, reproduces the publisher's golden values: every golden value the catalog can express is written as a structured query, compiled, run on the built warehouse and compared to docs/golden/golden.json, and every value it cannot express is listed with the reason. This is the deterministic half of the eval harness (S5b).
owned_paths: docs/sources.md, the two stale lines named in the S2 report (open point 3) only
out_of_scope: any change to src/agentic_bi/semantic/, catalog/metrics.yaml, warehouse/, docs/golden/ or data/: the S4 session owns the compiler tonight; a compiler defect is reported, not fixed
new catalog metrics or dimensions, even when a golden value needs one: list it as not expressible
the agent, the verifier and the question set (S4, S5a)
pyproject.toml, uv.lock and any network call
done_means: evals/golden_queries.yaml maps each golden id to one structured query (the S3a schema) or to not_expressible with a one-line reason; all 48 ids appear exactly once

uv run python -m agentic_bi.reproduce --out data/tmp/reproduction.json builds the warehouse with agentic_bi.warehouse.build into data/tmp/, compiles and runs every mapped query through the read-only query connection, and writes golden, reproduced and difference per id

a pytest test does the same and fails on any difference: amounts and counts equal to the cent; ratios compared by a tolerance rule written in docs/reproduction.md and justified there (the golden file stores six decimal places)
at least 30 golden values are reproduced, including at least five derived ones, the 12 fiscal months, the five recipients, the top-10 reporting share and the obligations of the null competition code
a value that does not match is never mapped to a different query to make it pass; it stays failing in the report with both numbers, and the test marks it xfail with the reason
docs/reproduction.md explains the mapping, the tolerance rule, how to rerun, and the table of not-expressible values, each tagged as a candidate catalog change or as out of scope by design
uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q && python3 scripts/commit_hygiene.py
stop_and_report_when: the warehouse does not build from main: report the error, change nothing under warehouse/
the compiler raises or returns a wrong value on a well-formed query: commit the failing case as xfail with the evidence and report it for the S4 owner
a dependency beyond the locked environment seems necessary
hand_back: The branch s3b-golden-reproduction, pushed to origin and never merged, with the report committed as tasks/reports/s3b-golden-reproduction.md: outcome, the verification output, the reproduction table (id, tag, golden, reproduced, difference), the not-expressible list, and any compiler finding. The owner opens the pull request from the pushed branch.
note: Plan row S3b. Serves ADR-0001 and ADR-0002. Starts after S2 (PR 4) and S3a (PR 2) are merged into main. Runs the same night as S3c, S4 and S5a; owned paths do not overlap. evals/golden_queries.yaml is the reference S5b will compare the question set against.
